detail: Listed in the LETA biography published by Apollo as one of the two secondary schools he attended; Latvian Wikipedia states that he spent his last two secondary-school years (1996–1998) at the Riga School of Commerce.
LSM, TV3 and LETA list the Riga School of Commerce in his education; the years are given by Latvian Wikipedia.

His candidate data for the 2022 Saeima and 2024 European Parliament elections, as published by LSM, give a bachelor's degree in international business from Concordia International University in 2002 (the LETA biography gives 2022, apparently a typing error). English Wikipedia also credits him with an MBA from the Riga Business School of Riga Technical University (2015); the sources consulted do not confirm it, so it is not listed here.
